_comment: Standards-manual publication manifest. A manual goes LIVE (download + Scholar/DOI metadata) only when status == 'published' AND its PDF exists at data/manuals/<pdf>. 'pending_refresh' = the manual exists but predates a values change (the 2026-06-20 round-DOWN rounding rule and/or an open adjudication like the seaweed iAs hold) and must be REGENERATED with current values + defensibility-audited before publishing. Publishing a stale/contaminated standard on the indexed cert site is a Daubert self-harm (a defective number is multiplied by the transparent-derivation posture). Flip to 'published' is a one-line edit after regen+audit.
publisher: Heavy Metal Tested & Certified, Paleo Foundation

manuals.title: Seafood
manuals.evidence_note: Firm cap-bound cells defensible (fish-marine-predatory Cd 50 / tHg 1000), but the manual predates the seaweed iAs hold — it likely still prints the iAs 2000 incomplete-pool artifact. Regenerate with current catalog (seaweed iAs held) before publishing.

manuals.title: Culinary Oils and Fats
manuals.evidence_note: Predates the round-DOWN rule + olive-oil clean/dirty adjudication. Regenerate + audit.

manuals.title: Butter and Ghee
manuals.evidence_note: Predates the round-DOWN rule. Regenerate + audit (check for any literature-baseline values affected by rounding).

manuals.title: Herbs, Spices and Salt
manuals.evidence_note: Spices Pb=600 is firm/cap-bound (defensible), but salt is still a Gate-1 hold (sea/rock/refined geology unresolved) — the manual may print provisional salt values. Regenerate after the salt adjudication.

manuals.title: Infant and Child Foods
manuals.evidence_note: SERVED artifact is the consolidated v2 (download_pdf): the FULL five-part Program Manual — Part 1 Why HMTc Exists, Part 2 The HMTc Program (governance + certification-status framework), Part 3 The Standards (all nine subcategories with derivations), Part 4 The Lot-Testing Schedule, Part 5 methodology/adversarial-read/glossary — rendered to content/static/manuals/ by tools/build-cat1-manual-pdf.mjs. Part 3's numbers come from the SAME compiled records the web edition reads (cannot drift; audited cell-for-cell by tools/audit-cat1-manual-pdf.mjs); Parts 1/2/4/5 are authored cert-plane content (data/manuals/cat1-manual/) reconciled from the current v2.1 Governance Policy + Lot-Testing Schedule and checked by tools/audit-cat1-manual-consistency.mjs. Government-limit only (no percentile-selection arithmetic). `pdf` is the earlier 384-page single-subcategory DEPOSITED volume (Zenodo concept 10.5281/zenodo.20270511; v0 20270512 2026-05-18, rev 20771543 2026-06-20) — kept in data/manuals for the record and to satisfy the presence gate, but NEVER served against this 9-subcategory edition (serving a stale standard is a Daubert self-harm). The deposited editions and their DOIs stay citable in the version-history edition table on the manual page; the current v2 has no DOI yet (Crossref deposit pending), which is expected.
manuals.landing_note: Web edition current (9 subcategories, 2026-08-06, Method v2.0). The consolidated v2 PDF is generated from the same data and is downloadable here; the earlier 384-page deposited editions remain citable on Zenodo via the edition record.

manuals.title: Grains, Cereals, and Rice Products
manuals.evidence_note: Web edition current (12 subcategories, full HMTc 10-analyte panel, Method v2.0 government-limit default; 2026-08-10). Rice inorganic-arsenic axis verified against EU 2023/915 (milled 150 / parboiled-husked / rice-flour 250 / rice products 300 / rice drinks 30). Consolidated version-pinned PDF in preparation.

manuals.title: Pet Foods
manuals.evidence_note: Web edition current (10 subcategories, Method v2.0 human-grade over-compliance; 2026-08-13). Pet food is legally feed; every value is the strictest human-food sovereign maximum for the nearest analog (feed floor disclosed, never selected), matching the live /standards/pet-food-* pages cell-for-cell. Rendered from the same cat17-compiled records the bespoke standard pages read (tools/standards/build-cert-cat17-pages.mjs). A PROVISIONAL PDF edition (tools/build-cat17-manual-pdf.mjs) is served for download NOW at Karen's direction (a brand requested the standard); status stays pending_refresh because no DOI-registered deposit exists yet — the served PDF carries an explicit provisional/pre-DOI notice and makes no citation/DOI claim.

manuals.title: Dairy and Milk Products
manuals.evidence_note: Web edition current (8 subcategories, Method v2.0 government-limit default; 2026-08-13). Every value matches the live /standards/dairy-* pages cell-for-cell. Consolidated version-pinned PDF in preparation.
